confd_path.description: Path pattern for configuration snippets to include.

ike_local_port.description: Local UDP port for IKE communication.

ike_remote_port.description: Remote UDP port for IKE communication.

ike_proposals.description: Comma separated proposals to accept for IKE.

ike_pull.description: Set the Mode Config mode to use (pull).

ike_dscp.description: Differentiated Services Field Codepoint to set on outgoing IKE packets (six binary digits).

ike_encap.description: Enforce UDP encapsulation by faking NAT-D payloads.

ike_fragmentation.description: Use IKE UDP datagram fragmentation (yes, accept, no or force).

ike_childless.description: Use childless IKE_SA initiation (allow, prefer, force or never).

ike_send_certreq.description: Send certificate requests payloads (yes or no).

ike_send_cert.description: Send certificate payloads (always, never or ifasked).

ike_ocsp.description: Request and send OCSP status in certificate request or certificate payloads (never, reply, _request or both).

ike_ppk_required.description: Whether a Postquantum Preshared Key (PPK) is required for this connection.

ike_keyingtries.description: Number of retransmission sequences to perform during initial connect.

ike_unique.description: Connection uniqueness policy (never, no, keep or replace).

ike_if_id_in.description: Default inbound XFRM interface ID for children.

ike_if_id_out.description: Default outbound XFRM interface ID for children.

ike_mediation.description: Whether this connection is a mediation connection.

ike_local_auth.description: Authentication to perform locally (pubkey, psk, xauth[-backend] or eap[-method]).

ike_remote_revocation.description: Certificate revocation policy, (strict, ifuri or relaxed).

ike_remote_auth.description: Authentication to expect from remote (pubkey, psk, xauth[-backend] or eap[-method]).

child_esp_proposals.description: ESP proposals to offer for the CHILD_SA.

child_local_ts.description: Local traffic selectors to include in CHILD_SA.

child_remote_ts.description: Remote selectors to include in CHILD_SA.

child_updown.description: Updown script to invoke on CHILD_SA up and down events.

child_hostaccess.description: Hostaccess variable to pass to updown script.

child_mode.description: IPsec Mode to establish (tunnel, transport, transport_proxy, beet, pass or drop).

child_policies.description: Whether to install IPsec policies or not.

child_policies_fwd_out.description: Whether to install outbound FWD IPsec policies or not.

child_dpd_action.description: Action to perform on DPD timeout (clear, trap or restart).

child_inactivity.description: Timeout before closing CHILD_SA after inactivity.

child_reqid.description: Fixed reqid to use for this CHILD_SA.

child_priority.description: Optional fixed priority for IPsec policies.

child_interface.description: Optional interface name to restrict IPsec policies.

child_mark_in.description: Netfilter mark and mask for input traffic.

child_mark_in_sa.description: Whether to set *mark_in* on the inbound SA.

child_mark_out.description: Netfilter mark and mask for output traffic.

child_set_mark_in.description: Netfilter mark applied to packets after the inbound IPsec SA processed them.

child_set_mark_out.description: Netfilter mark applied to packets after the outbound IPsec SA processed them.

child_if_id_in.description: Inbound XFRM interface ID (32-bit unsigned integer).

child_if_id_out.description: Outbound XFRM interface ID (32-bit unsigned integer).

child_label_mode.description: Security label mode (system, simple or selinux), IKEv2 only.

child_replay_window.description: IPsec replay window to configure for this CHILD_SA.

child_hw_offload.description: Enable hardware offload for this CHILD_SA, if supported by the IPsec implementation.

child_copy_df.description: Whether to copy the DF bit to the outer IPv4 header in tunnel mode.

child_copy_ecn.description: Whether to copy the ECN header field to/from the outer IP header in tunnel mode.

child_copy_dscp.description: Whether to copy the DSCP header field to/from the outer IP header in tunnel mode.

child_start_action.description: Action to perform after loading the configuration (none, trap, start).

child_close_action.description: Action to perform after a CHILD_SA gets closed (none, trap, start).
